title: BenchmarkArtifact.v1
description: An OpenBenchmarkHub benchmark definition: WHAT to measure (capability slots, datasets/tasks, metrics) + its limits + suitability. A benchmark is EVIDENCE, not authority — it is RUN_BY a HarnessArtifact (OpenHarnessHub) and its results cannot by themselves promote a Teleon candidate or become Baltor truth. External benchmarks are catalogued as owner_provided_unverified until confirmed against their official source.

harnesses.description: OpenHarnessHub harness ids that RUN this benchmark (or [] + a missing reason)

expected_results.description: first-party benchmarks: the ground-truth answer/held-out facts

status_code.description: 200 candidate · 500 active reference (never a truth authority)
